purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 461 Suhaj (city code 7228); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: Egyptian Survey Authority and Sohag Governorate / Sohag City local administration
registryBasis: Official Egyptian Survey Authority material documents a cooperation protocol with Sohag Governorate to inventory and digitize government-owned lands using GIS; this is a government-asset inventory, not evidence of a public or comprehensive private-parcel cadastre. The Authority’s digital-map service is request-based: applicants specify area/scale/layers/projection, review and pay a quote. No anonymous polygon route was verified.

officialSources.observation: Direct anonymous ESA page states that the Authority and Sohag Governorate agreed on a GIS program to inventory/digitize state-owned land assets and deter encroachment; this is not a public private-parcel feature service. Direct anonymous GET returned HTTP 200 (17,815 bytes).
Egyptian Survey Authority services include digital-map products and surveying services.
ESA digital maps are requested by letter with location, scale, selected layers and projection, then inspected, quoted, paid for and delivered.
ESA directorates map is an office locator, not a cadastral feature service.
